Genesis Magma Racing Confirms Full Driver Lineup for 2027 FIA WEC Season

28 Oct 2026, 02:09 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Auto Desk · Source: motorsport.hyundai.com

2 min read

मुख्य बातेंGenesis Magma Racing has announced its six-driver roster for the 2027 FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC), maintaining the same lineup that competed during the team's inaugural season in the series. The decision emphasizes continuity as the squad seeks to build upon its rookie-year progress with the GMR-001 Hypercar.

Driver Lineup Retained for Second Season

Genesis Magma Racing has announced its six-driver roster for the 2027 FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC), maintaining the same lineup that competed during the team's inaugural season in the series. The decision emphasizes continuity as the squad seeks to build upon its rookie-year progress with the GMR-001 Hypercar.

Building on Debut Success

During its first WEC campaign, Genesis Magma Racing achieved multiple milestones. The #17 GMR-001 secured the team's first championship points at the 6 Hours of Spa-Francorchamps in only its second race. Later that season, the same car claimed Genesis Magma Racing's first FIA WEC pole position at the 6 Hours of Barcelona. The team also completed its maiden 24 Hours of Le Mans, marking another key objective.

इस विषय पर और पढ़ेंऑटोमोबाइलजेनेसिस मैग्मा रेसिंग का लक्ष्य मोंज़ा में अपने पहले FIA WEC सीज़न का अंत करना हैह्यूंदै बायन सीएनजी: जनवरी 2027 में लॉन्च हो सकती है नई एसयूवी

Leadership Comments

Team Principal Cyril Abiteboul highlighted the value of retaining experienced personnel: "Continuity is essential at this stage of our programme. Our drivers have built valuable knowledge of the GMR-001 Hypercar and strong working relationships with our technical team."

Sporting Director Gabriele Tarquini added: "They work very well together and have built a strong relationship with the entire team, so we are very pleased to continue with this group next season."

Car Assignments Pending

While the six drivers have been confirmed, Genesis Magma Racing stated that the specific driver assignments for each of its two GMR-001 entries will be finalized before the opening race of the 2027 season.

Practical Implications

Retaining the full driver lineup suggests Genesis Magma Racing prioritizes development consistency over roster experimentation. This approach mirrors strategies used by established manufacturers like Toyota and Porsche, who often maintain stable driver pairings to maximize car development feedback.

The team's 2026 performance indicates steady improvement. Scoring points regularly remains a realistic target for 2027, particularly if the GMR-001 continues evolving through accumulated data and driver input.

What Remains Unknown

Several details about the 2027 season remain unconfirmed, including final car-number allocations, race-by-race driver rotations, and technical updates planned for the GMR-001. Additionally, no new sponsor partnerships or livery designs were announced alongside the driver confirmation.

How to Verify

Fans and media can access the official announcement through Hyundai's motorsport website at motorsport.hyundai.com. For press inquiries, contact media@hyundai-ms.com. The FIA WEC schedule and regulations are available at fiawec.com.
